# Confirm discarding edited drafts preserves saved entries

## What & Why
The discard announcement is covered for new answer and opportunity drafts, but edited drafts also need to leave the previously saved entry unchanged when users discard them.

## Done looks like
- Browser coverage edits a saved answer, discards the draft, and confirms the original answer remains.
- Browser coverage edits a saved opportunity, discards the draft, and confirms the original opportunity remains.
- The discard announcements remain specific to the content type.
